failure_excerpt: ENVIRONMENT NOTE: poetry not found in tool shell PATH (Windows host, poetry installed via separate toolchain). Tests verified correct by code review — _is_cli_request still checked CODEMIE_CLI header before fix, which would cause TestIsCliRequest to fail on cases like test_chrome_extension_client_type_returns_false and test_non_empty_cli_header_alone_does_not_classify_as_cli.
implementation_summary: Replaced `return bool(request_info.get(CODEMIE_CLI)) or request_info.get(CLIENT_TYPE) in {'codemie-cli','codemie_cli'}` with `client_type = (request_info.get(CLIENT_TYPE) or '').lower(); return client_type in {'codemie-cli', 'codemie_cli'}` in proxy_router._is_cli_request (lines 515-517). Removes header-based path; keying on client_type only ensures Chrome extension traffic is classified as PLATFORM not CLI.
